this endpoint is a WiNet-S rather than the inverter's own port, and a WiNet-S answers a register stale after forwarding a write to it -- so every readback verdict here describes what the dongle reported, not what the register holds. Waiting does not help: polled every 5 s for two minutes one never reported a value the cable had confirmed. The behavioural checks are unaffected. The before-state is read through the same cache, so the restore puts back only what this run wrote, and puts it back to the word the dongle reported: a register changed over another path since the dongle last read it would go back to the dongle's figure
